title: Almost a Grill Pan
text:
Almost a Grill Pan. UPDATE 03/10/2018:
I initially rated this pan 3 stars. Having had this pan only about 5 months, large swaths of the Teflon are already coming off, and we've never scrubbed it with anything abrasive or used hard utensils in it. This is a new record (for me) for how quickly the non-stick coating comes off a treated pan. Based on this, I am dropping my rating to 1 star - stay far, far away from this pan. It's a poor product that will fail you sooner rather than later.

My original review follows.

---

I selected this pan for my wife, as she likes to use my cast-iron grill pans but she doesn’t like the clean-up afterward. I will confess that I am no fan of Teflon-coated pans, so I wasn’t too sure about this one. It has turned out to be a decent pan (if you don’t mind Teflon) but there are a couple of negatives that merit attention.

Farberware is not a high-end name in cookware, so I wasn’t expecting this to be a spectacular pan, particularly at the price. I was a bit surprised, though, when I received it – it seems to be very solid with a tightly-attached handle and it is very solidly balanced. This is a big plus, as I have had too many pans that aren’t quite flat on the bottom and as such will wobble on the burner and will heat unevenly. Being aluminum, it heats quickly and because it’s flat it seems to heat evenly. So far, so good.

Some of the other reviewers here have stated that the finish started coming off after the first washing. I have hand-washed this pan several times and so far the finish and the non-stick coating have not shown any signs of coming off. The pan is supposedly dishwasher safe; I have not tried it in the dishwasher so I do not know how well it will hold up in there.

My first issue with this pan is that the ridges aren’t really high enough to make this a proper grill pan. It does leave some grill marks when pre-heated and it does a good job of frying, but it is a poor substitute for most grilling surfaces. Because the ridges are wide and high, it does not grill foods like most other surfaces so the result is something that is more fried than grilled. That said, the ridges are high enough to allow some fats to drain away, so you will end up with moderately lower fat than straight frying, though that depends on how soft and amorphous the food you’re cooking is.

The bottom of the pan is textured and has a neat feel to it, but be careful when running your hand over it. The finer ridges on the bottom aren’t necessarily smooth and I nicked my hand when I ran it across the surface. This was an unpleasant (and unwelcome) surprise. It’s a minor point as most people are not going to make a habit of doing that, but it’s something to remember.

My wife is happy with this pan, though I am not. She has used it several times and it very pleased with how well it works for her and how easy to clean it is. I still prefer my cast iron grill pans and will continue to use them instead, even though cleanup is more work. If the goal is easy cleanup and some fat reduction, this pan is worth a look. If you want a proper grill pan, though, there are better choices available, even in the same general price range.

product_metadata.title: Farberware Dishwasher Safe Nonstick Aluminum 10.5-Inch Round Grill Pan, Red
features: The round grill pan's heavy duty construction promotes quick and even heating to reduce hotspots that can burn food
The durable nonstick interior provides easy food release and effortless care and maintenance
For additional convenience the grill pan is dishwasher safe for quicker, easier cleanup
The grill pan's strong, comfortable handle provides a confident grip; the pan is oven safe to 350 degrees Fahrenheit
description: This Farberware Dishwasher Safe Nonstick Aluminum 10-1/2-Inch Round Grill Pan is sure to be a hit with cooks who love making fast, flavorful food. The grill pan is constructed from heavy-duty aluminum that heats quickly and evenly to help reduce hot spots that can burn food. Long-lasting nonstick coats the grill pan's interior for excellent food release, whether you're cooking hot dogs or fish fillets and the raised ridges allow oils and other fats to drip away from both pork chops and chicken. The round grill pan is also dishwasher safe for no-hassle and convenient cleanup. The strong, comfortable handle provides a confident grasp so the pan can be transported with ease. Finally, the grill pan is oven safe to 350 Degree F making it ideal for searing a thick porterhouse over a burner before finishing it in the oven. With a Farberware Dishwasher Safe Nonstick Aluminum 10-1/2-Inch Round Grill Pan in the kitchen, bold grilled flavors are easy to achieve, no matter the weather or season.
